name: desktop-library-light
prompt:
USER REQUESTED CORRECTION to the supplied Wave Player card image. Preserve the exact composition, card silhouette, typography hierarchy (TX-02 title and times, Inter metadata, selective Departure Mono short state markers), signal art, waveform and all dimensions. Edit only the utilities and icon styling:
DELETE the "A/B" text action in the CENTER BETWEEN THE TIME LABELS. Leave that center empty; 01:24 left and04:32 right remain.
In the bottom-left replace the list + "Library" text with a small ICON-ONLY Phosphor Queue glyph (list with small play triangle). No text label displayed. Next to it, separated by8px, add a small ICON-ONLY Phosphor Repeat glyph (two curved return arrows) for loop access. These two secondary icons form one small left utility group. Use consistent regular Phosphor stroke weight about1.5px at16-18px visible size, modest24px visual control regions, no big boxes. This is NOT a tab selector. No text "A/B" button or "Library" button.
The previous/Pause/next group stays CENTERED at exactly the same position, with Phosphor SkipBack/Pause/SkipForward shapes. The small far-right volume icon is Phosphor SpeakerHigh, no visible slider. Utilities do not crowd the centered transport. No new Settings or theme control inside the card. Broader app Settings is outside this crop.
Keep loop boundary A and B labels ONLY if this reference already shows active loop editing; these are legitimate editing markers, not buttons. If loop is active, give Repeat a subtle neutral selected background; otherwise leave it quiet and unfilled.
Keep every other text, region, caption and aspect unchanged. One individual image, not variants/contact sheet. Exact board caption outside UI "Design fixture — simulated waveform and playback".
This companion-library state has LOOP ACTIVE. Preserve A00:48/B01:36 fields, Loop checkmark and Reset, and all five library rows. Switch library-row glyphs and panel close glyph to matching Phosphor regular style. Preserve no-tabs layout.
